t: Script and fix malformed session folders across framework and hub spokes
challenge: Malformed session folders exist: 083-tuesday-forge (no session- prefix), unsorted-tracks/ (orphan), two hub folders with 6-digit timestamps (HHMMSS instead of HHMM). Non-standard entries cause confusion and break tooling that expects session-YYYYMMDD-HHMM format.
perceive: 1. ls framework/WAI-Spoke/sessions/ — find 083-tuesday-forge and unsorted-tracks/. 2. ls hub/WAI-Spoke/sessions/ — find session-20260326-090918 and session-20260326-170206. 3. Read track files inside malformed folders to extract correct dates. 4. Check canonical format: session-YYYYMMDD-HHMM (4-digit time).
execute: 1. Create tools/fix_session_folders.py with --dry-run mode. Script scans WAI-Spoke/sessions/, identifies non-compliant entries, renames 6-digit times to 4-digit, moves non-session entries to sessions/archive/. 2. Run --dry-run on framework and hub. 3. Run for real on framework and hub. 4. Add to gardener remediation: run fix_session_folders.py as part of spoke health remediation.
verify: 1. python3 tools/fix_session_folders.py --dry-run shows 0 non-compliant across framework and hub. 2. All session folders match session-YYYYMMDD-HHMM pattern. 3. No data lost (orphan tracks archived, not deleted).

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Script to detect and fix malformed session folder names, then run it across framework and hub
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not modifying session content or track files — only folder naming
